lead_raw_text:
The structure of MnFeSi is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119), containing 12 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Fe and Mn centers each have 12 geometric neighbors (Fe: 4 Mn, 8 Si; Mn: 4 Fe, 8 Si), while Si centers have 12 mixed neighbors (4 Fe, 4 Mn, 4 Si), all with neighbor distances near 2.49–2.53 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Fe and Mn 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among like Fe–Fe and Mn–Mn polyhedra.
